# Online Reader Framework demo books

> Three books read in the Online Reader Framework demo. Each is available as plain Markdown: an index, the whole text in one file, and one file per section.

## Books

- [Deliberate Practice: A Universal Learning Method](https://deliberatepractice.dominiklukes.net/agent/deliberate-practice/index.md): Dominik Lukeš. 21 sections (21 with text), about 36,825 words. [Full text](https://deliberatepractice.dominiklukes.net/agent/deliberate-practice/full.md) · [Manifest](https://deliberatepractice.dominiklukes.net/agent/deliberate-practice/manifest.json) · [Read in the browser](https://deliberatepractice.dominiklukes.net/?book=deliberate-practice) · Licence: [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
- [Building Your Language Muscle](https://buildingyourlanguagemuscle.edutools.fyi/agent/language-muscle/index.md): Dominik Lukeš. 12 sections (12 with text), about 13,081 words. [Full text](https://buildingyourlanguagemuscle.edutools.fyi/agent/language-muscle/full.md) · [Manifest](https://buildingyourlanguagemuscle.edutools.fyi/agent/language-muscle/manifest.json) · [Read in the browser](https://buildingyourlanguagemuscle.edutools.fyi/?book=language-muscle)
- [Introduction to Key Issues in Language Through Stack Exchange Answers from Linguistics Stack Exchange, 2013–2016](https://linguistics.dominiklukes.net/agent/linguistics/index.md): Dominik Lukeš. 262 sections (253 with text), about 76,526 words. [Full text](https://linguistics.dominiklukes.net/agent/linguistics/full.md) · [Manifest](https://linguistics.dominiklukes.net/agent/linguistics/manifest.json) · [Read in the browser](https://linguistics.dominiklukes.net/?book=linguistics)
